title: Public Body (Generic) product catalogue, version 1
sourceDescription: Selected product evidence from current vendor pages, checked on 21 November 2026. Claims state what the vendor describes, not proven suitability for an organisation. Editorial review is pending. Coverage spans the sector’s main capability areas but is not exhaustive; a missing product is not evidence that no product exists.
